user.title: Location
user.description: Choose the observing location. Coordinates are validated against Open-Meteo before the integration is added.

preset.title: Scoring preset
preset.description: Choose how strict the scoring should be, and your preferred darkness for a usable night. The darkest chosen tier is used when it's reachable; otherwise the window falls back to a shallower one so a night is never skipped.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to contact Open-Meteo. Check the coordinates and try again.

init.title: Scoring preset
init.description: Pick the baseline preset. The following pages are prefilled from it -- keeping your current preset keeps your tuned values, switching to a different preset resets every tuning page to that preset's numbers.

night.title: Night type
night.description: How dark does a night need to be? The darkest reachable tier in your chosen chain is used, falling back shallower so a night is never skipped.

cloud_thresholds.title: Cloud thresholds
cloud_thresholds.description: Hours at or below each ceiling score a perfect 100 for that cloud layer.

sky_thresholds.title: Sky and seeing thresholds
sky_thresholds.description: 'ceiling' factors score 100 at or below their value; 'floor' factors (spread, visibility) score 100 at or above.

falloff_spans.title: Falloff spans
falloff_spans.description: How far past each threshold the factor's score takes to fall from 100 to 0. Bigger span = gentler penalty.

weights.title: Factor weights
weights.description: How much each factor matters, 0-5. They do not need to sum to anything -- scores normalize automatically. Next up: notifications.

notify_setup.title: Notifications
notify_setup.description: Get pinged when tonight’s peak score reaches your threshold. Checked once daily at the time below, against tonight’s freshest forecast.

data.notify_score_threshold: Minimum peak score to notify about

notify_target.title: Notify target
notify_target.description: Where should the notification be delivered? Only currently registered notify entities are listed (e.g. your phone via the Companion App).

error.no_notify_entities: No notify entities found. Set up a notification platform first -- e.g. install the Home Assistant Companion App on your phone -- then rerun these options.
